hero.title: Events
hero.subtitle: Weddings, communions, birthdays, companies and celebrations with character in an exclusive rural setting in Campos de Montiel.

intro: At Los Collados de San Miguel we organise all kinds of events with an intimate, personalised character: from weddings of up to 50 guests to executive meetings, shootings or photo sessions in a unique natural setting.

capacity.title: Capacities
items: Lodging: up to 16 adults (+ children according to booking)

eventTypes.title: Types of event we host
eventTypes.lead: Each celebration is tailored to the group, dates and style. These are the most usual formats on the estate:

items.title: Weddings
items.description: Ceremonies and banquets of up to 50 guests in gardens, porch and rooms, with complete privacy.

items.title: Golden and silver wedding anniversaries
items.description: Special anniversaries with a menu, set-up and a carefully judged atmosphere for family and friends.

items.title: Birthdays
items.description: Family or friends’ celebrations, indoors or outdoors, with catering to order.

items.title: Communions
items.description: Intimate gatherings after the ceremony, with space for children and a menu adapted to the group.

items.title: Product presentations
items.description: Launches, showcookings and meetings with press or clients in a distinctive setting.

items.title: Companies
items.description: Conventions, incentives, teambuilding and team days, with optional lodging.

items.title: Shootings
items.description: Advertising, fashion and product campaigns with multiple settings on the same estate. Indoor and outdoor photo sessions.

items.title: Executive meetings
items.description: Strategic gatherings in a reserved setting, with rooms and work areas.

blocks.title: What we offer
paragraphs: Outdoor spaces with porch, gardens and pool for open-air celebrations.
Library lounge, dining room and indoor areas for more intimate or climate-controlled gatherings.
Bungalow lodging for guests who stay overnight, and exclusive use of the estate on booking.
Coordination with Azurea Catering for menus, set-up and waiting service at your event.

azurea.title: Azurea Catering
paragraphs: For weddings, communions, birthdays and celebrations on the estate we work with Azurea Catering, a Ciudad Real company specialised in reinterpreting traditional La Mancha cooking with a contemporary, creative, high-quality approach.

Azurea designs exclusive menus that can be adapted to each occasion — from cocktails and banquets to corporate service — with nearby produce and a professional team that knows the spaces of Los Collados de San Miguel thoroughly.
Catering is quoted independently of the estate hire. We advise you so that dates, set-up and logistics can be coordinated with Azurea’s team.

alts.staff: Azurea Catering staff serving at an event

venuePackages.title: Booking options
venuePackages.lead: Choose the formula that best fits your event. Price on request; catering with Azurea is quoted separately.

cta.title: Plan your event
cta.text: Tell us your dates, number of guests and type of celebration. We will advise you with no obligation.

form.title: Plan your event
form.intro: Weddings, communions, birthdays, companies, shootings or photo sessions. Give dates, guests and type of celebration.
